preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer n, where 3 ≤ n ≤ 5000, representing the length of the unknown array.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**5 for x in stdin.split()[1:]) if len(stdin.split()) > 1 else True
preconditions.description: If the input contains more than one line (for testing), the array elements are positive integers not exceeding 10^5. This is only relevant for testing and not part of the interactive problem's input.

postconditions.description: The final output line must start with '!' followed by exactly n space-separated integers representing the guessed array.

postconditions.expression:
all('?' in line for line in stdout.strip().split('
')[:-1]) and all(line.startswith('?') for line in stdout.strip().split('
')[:-1])
postconditions.description: Every line of stdout except the last must be a query in the format '? i j' where i and j are distinct indices between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression:
len([line for line in stdout.strip().split('
') if line.startswith('?')]) <= int(stdin.split()[0])
postconditions.description: The total number of queries (lines starting with '?') must not exceed n.

postconditions.expression:
all(1 <= int(i) <= int(stdin.split()[0]) and 1 <= int(j) <= int(stdin.split()[0]) and int(i) != int(j) for line in stdout.strip().split('
') if line.startswith('?') for i, j in [line.split()[1:]] if len(line.split()) == 3)
postconditions.description: Every query must contain two distinct indices i and j, each between 1 and n (inclusive).

postconditions.expression:
all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**5 for x in stdout.strip().split('
')[-1].split()[1:])
postconditions.description: The guessed array elements in the final line must be positive integers not exceeding 10^5.
